description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineModuleServiceMock' for the 'IMediaPipelineModuleService' interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto media server IPC component. It includes mock methods for various IPC-related operations such as client connection management, session control, media control commands, and source management.

classes.name: MediaPipelineModuleServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaPipelineModuleService interface for testing purposes.
